snippet.title: Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey - SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/trunkeys-amazing-odyssey-sage-2025-demo.2515/
(SAGE is already over, but that's not going to stop me from putting the trailer here!)

THAT'S RIGHT! Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey is at SAGE 2025!

Explore and collect shiny objects as you guide Trunkey through a hostile and unpredictable world in the first official demo release of the game!

(Music by LaunchpadVGM)
